newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Soccer-Ireland under-21 team to meet Iceland.
newsitem.headline: Soccer-Ireland under-21 team to meet Iceland.

text.p: Republic of Ireland under-21 manager Ian Evans on Friday named his team to meet Iceland at Dalymount Park on Saturday (kick-off 1945 GMT).
The side shows just one change from that which beat Macedonia 4-0 at the same venue on October 8 with Willie Boland replacing Owen Coll of Bournemouth.

1-Brendan Murphy (Wimbledon); 4-Dave Worrell (Blackburn Rovers), 5-Gavin O'Toole (Coventry City), 6-Ross Darcy (Tottenham Hotspur); 2-Stephen Carr (Tottenham Hotspur), 7-Keith O'Halloran (Middlesbrough), 10-Willie Boland (Coventry City), 11-Gareth Farrelly (Aston Villa), 3-Mark Kennedy (Liverpool, Captain); 8-Steven Finnan (Notts County), 9-Dominic Foley (Wolverhampton Wanderers).
